headline: Weathered Expanse Holds Lead as Hollow Stays Hot
war_summary: Three hours further on finds the wires thinner but the same desks still filing. The Weathered Expanse holds the lead with six changes in two hours and sixty in the day about Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk, standing one Warden, five Colonial and three neutral after 6,994 Colonial and 7,890 Warden casualties in the day. Marban Hollow files five changes in two hours and thirty-seven in the day at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, now two Warden, four Colonial and two neutral. Kuura Strand adds two late changes and twenty-nine in the day at Faden Point and Menneen for two Warden and four Colonial. Nevish Line counts one late change but fourteen in six hours and thirty-five in the day at Princefal and Blackcoat Way, even at four apiece. Linn Mercy has gone quiet with none in two hours after six in six and ten in the day at Lathair, while Godcrofts shows none in two hours after six in six at Argosa and Lipsia. Callahan's Passage and the Deadlands still bleed heavily with 4,219 and 1,525 Colonial casualties in the day and no recorded flip.
